position_on: the key's own pole: funding affordable and public housing for people who cannot afford market rents
confidence_reason: Three of his own Senate releases from 2023 to 2026 call a decent, affordable home a fundamental human right, call for building millions of units of low-income, affordable housing and back his bill to rebuild public housing; held at 0.8 because none of his sources found speaks to eviction limits or renter protections, which the key also covers.

sources.excerpt: "Simply put, a decent, safe, and affordable place to live is a fundamental human right, not a privilege" ... "We must do more to make sure all Vermonters have a place to call home."
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-25 (the release's full text, as published on his Senate site). Release on National Housing Trust Fund money for Vermont. Only the quote attributed to Sanders is used.

sources.type: press release (own Senate office, prepared floor remarks, sanders.senate.gov)

sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-25 (the release's full text, as published on his Senate site). His prepared floor remarks on the 2025 budget, published by his office.
